first.rationale: Two metrics are declining simultaneously (activation -6%, onboarding completion -4%), suggesting a compounding degradation in early-stage funnel health. Memory_31 and memory_86 both demonstrate that onboarding simplification drives durable, direct improvements in activation and early adoption without negative downstream effects on retention or revenue quality. This directly addresses the immediate performance decline. I am verifying memory_31 and memory_73 to confirm the historical reliability of onboarding simplification as a growth lever and to triangulate whether promotional pricing remains viable as a secondary option given the competitive threat. However, onboarding simplification is the higher-confidence play: it addresses both flagged metrics simultaneously, leverages proven mechanics from our own recent experience, and avoids the downstream revenue-quality risks associated with entry-level pricing erosion in a commoditizing competitive environment. The experiment can run at standard scale with low risk and clear measurement points.

final.rationale: The archive verification confirms the core thesis: signup simplification drove +9% activation and +4% qualified revenue with minimal retention impact (-1%), and critically, this effect holds durably on SMB. In contrast, memory_73 reveals that promotional pricing creates a retention cliff (-12%) and does not sustain revenue—exactly the opposite of our stated primary objective (maximize sustainable long-term qualified revenue). Given the current 6% activation decline and 4% onboarding completion decline, simplifying onboarding aligns with proven mechanics that improve both metrics without downstream cohort quality degradation. The competitive pricing pressure makes retention-safe growth even more valuable; we cannot afford acquisition that does not stick. Running this as a standard experiment on SMB onboarding flow this week will generate directional evidence on whether the earlier simplification effect can be re-engaged or whether the recent decline reflects segment shift or new friction that a fresh simplification iteration can address.
